verdict.rationale: Docs show a fast quickstart (API key → agent → call → transcript in ~5 minutes), Agent Studio generating a call-ready agent from a description in 5-8 minutes, prompt/voice/language configuration, and phone number/telephony setup via built-in providers or BYOT — collectively supporting a sub-hour path to a first live call. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the full end-to-end timing claim, and clearer evidence of phone number provisioning UX specifically (vs BYOT/SIP setup complexity).
